description: Schedule Pro turns your project schedule into a clear, interactive story inside Power BI. Purpose-built for planners, schedulers, and project-controls teams, it reads Primavera P6 (XER) and Microsoft Project (XML) files directly - no data modeling required - and presents your programme across ten connected views. WHAT YOU GET • Interactive Gantt chart - a Primavera-style, collapsible WBS grid beside a zoomable timeline. Activity, summary, milestone and baseline bars, dependency arrows, critical-path highlighting, the data-date line, and a fully configurable, resizable, reorderable column set. Sort activities by Start or Finish date with one click. • S-Curve & Histogram - planned, actual and forecast cumulative curves with period histograms, on a units or cost basis, split at your cut-off date. • Progress Summary Table - planned-vs-actual roll-ups by WBS tier with subtotals, variance indicators, a time-phased unit/cost profile, and per-column formatting. • EVM Dashboard - earned-value KPIs (BAC, PV, EV, AC, SPI, CPI, EAC, VAC), the EVM curve, SPI/CPI gauges with trend, and per-WBS performance. • DCMA 14-Point Check - the standard schedule-quality assessment with a pass/fail scorecard. • Resources - resource roll-ups, a stacked time-phased his, and a searchable resource slicer. • Calendars - project work calendars, work weeks and holidays in a month grid. • Stress Risk Analysis…
